bench_setup = function() {
	set.seed(20261117)
	n = 100L
	xs = matrix(rnorm(n * 5L), n, 5L)
	y = as.numeric(rbinom(n, 1, stats::plogis(0.5 * xs[, 1] - 0.3 * xs[, 2])))
	list(xs = xs, y = y, n_steps = c(40L, 60L, 80L, 100L))
}
stands_in_for: R/EDI/R/design_seq_one_by_one_KK21.R:431 (compute_weight_KK21_incidence -> fast_logistic_regression_with_var, default optimization_alg="lbfgs" at R/EDI/R/helper_glm_fit.R:923)
notes: Times the KK21 incidence covariate-weight computation: 20 two-column logistic fits (5 covariates at n_t = 40, 60, 80, 100) through the exported wrapper, lbfgs default vs irls; compares slope, its variance and the weight. tol is 1e-3 rather than 10x 1e-8 because the lbfgs side stops on LBFGSpp's relative f-decrease (delta=1e-8) at |f|~50, leaving ~1e-4 parameter error. Data are drawn to avoid separation, so the covariate-drop retry path (where the two optimizers could drop different columns) is not exercised.
